message.content:
Quick heads-up, folks: the north gate will be shut this Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. We're fixing a leaking water pipe — not glamorous, but it's got to be done. Please use the east entrance instead. It's the one by the compost bays, and yes, the path is a bit muddy, so watch your step.

Because of that, the seed swap is moving to Sunday at 11 am. Same spot, same friendly chaos of envelopes and mystery beans. Bring your spare seeds if you have them; there's no pressure if you don't.

Volunteers: we'd love your help. Bring gloves — tools are supplied. Mina coordinates the volunteer crew, so check in with her when you arrive. She'll point you toward the right job and probably hand you a cup of tea at some point.

Thanks for rolling with the change. See you Sunday, or Saturday at the east gate. — Northbank Community Garden
